items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I saw Paquito D’Rivera yesterday. He sent me a lead sheet... I said, “‘Paquito, what are you trying to do, flatter me?”

ctx.x: I was going to ask. I hope you do.

Yeah. She has one of those handbills, I’m going to put it in my book. But you know Art had me come by his house after junior high school every day. All the other kids would go junking you know, or chasing after the girls or football or baseball. I had to go by Art’s house. And he would play these phrases for me to sing. And he’d say, “sing this.” And I noticed that his eyes were closed. So I thought well, he must know something. So I said when I started to sing it, I’ll close my eyes. You know and I closed my…
Play it once for me though, right?
